name: CloudCurl Heatless Curling Rod
description: Soft satin-covered foam rod you wrap damp or dry hair around before bed and wake up with curls or waves, no heat tools.
key_features: Satin cover, soft foam core — comfortable to sleep on
Includes 2 scrunchies and a claw clip
Works on medium to long hair
target_audience_hint: Women 18-45 who want curls without damaging hair or waking up early
brand_notes: Fun, relatable tone. Do not say it repairs damage or makes hair healthier.
